turns.name: Meeting Room Inquiry
turns.replySubject: Re: Meeting Room Booking - Park Hyatt KL
turns.replyBody:
Dear Keagan Chang,

Thank you for contacting Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur regarding your upcoming meeting.

We offer two distinct venues suitable for your meeting:

1. Executive Salons (Level 98):
• Seats 6-18 people.
• Features 4K UHD presentation screens, integrated wireless video conferencing, and in-room complimentary coffee & tea.

2. Level 114 Sky Rooms (Level 114):
• Seats 18 - 80 people.
• Panoramic skyline view from the highest event floor in Kuala Lumpur.
• Flexible configurations (Boardroom, U-Shape, Classroom, Theater).

To finalise your booking, could you kindly confirm:
• Date & Time
• Number of People
• Room Configuration

Thank you. We look forward to your response

Warm regards,
Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur
